item.title: Federal Appeals Court Revives Health System’s 340B Whistleblower Lawsuit Against Four Drugmakers
item.description: A federal appeals court on Tuesday revived a California health system’s whistleblower lawsuit alleging four major drugmakers overcharged for 340B drugs, in a significant decision that could open a new legal pathway for providers to challenge alleged overcharges.

item.title: 340B Plays Key Role at House E&C Subcommittee Hearing on Health Costs
item.description: A key U.S. House subcommittee turned its attention to the 340B program Wednesday, with its GOP chairman calling it “opaque,” the head of a major hospital group urging lawmakers to safeguard the drug discount and a vocal 340B critic asking the panel to replace 340B with a safety-net grant.

item.title: State Contract Pharmacy Lawsuit Roundup: Actions in Maryland, Rhode Island, South Dakota and Oregon
item.description: Editor’s Note: With 340B-related litigation heating up in several states following the enactment of new contract pharmacy access laws, 340B Report has launched a roundup to keep our subscribers up to date on the most important legal developments.

item.title: Idaho Lawmakers Look to Narrow 340B Reporting Law as Minnesota Delays Action on Strengthened Contract Pharmacy Bill
item.description: Idaho legislators recently introduced a bill to simplify the state’s current 340B provider reporting law enacted last year, while Minnesota lawmakers postponed action on legislation to strengthen the state’s existing contract pharmacy access statute.

item.description: As prescription drug affordability boards take shape in states across the country, 340B experts have raised concerns over potential impacts on the program.

item.title: Advocacy Group Launches Litigation Fund to Help States Defend 340B Contract Pharmacy Access Laws
item.description: A national 340B advocacy group on Wednesday launched a new fund aimed at helping states defend 340B contract pharmacy access laws against a growing wave of drugmaker lawsuits.

item.title: House Members Circulate Letter to Ban 340B Rebate Model in Federal Funding Bill
item.description: A group of bipartisan key U.S. House lawmakers are pushing to include language in a must-pass federal appropriations bill that would block implementation of a 340B rebate model.
